checks.name: recipe totals close to original prices, unconditional wage/resale loss and no immediate purchase bypass
all three types consume exact mixed local stocks once and pay wage once without quest premiums
short material, low cash, remote stocks and invalid type are inert
FIFO leftovers and unknown purchase cost stay unchanged; consumed origins are not relabelled
global rent debt blocks construction without consuming old materials or paying debt implicitly
consuming legitimate oversized old materials handles the transition to normal rented space
exact due dates and repeated opening/processing deliver exactly once for each type
completion during real arrival preserves ship references, convoy and active selection; new ship stays at yard
start failure, cancellation, reentry and stale confirmation preserve material and cash
failed delivery keeps due order; retry creates one ship and consumes no RNG
waiting is atomic and rolls back completion, days and events when final save fails
harbor-work staging completes ship without intermediate write and cannot repeat wages
reserved fleet slot and one-order ceiling cannot be bypassed
v9 migration preserves every original value and immutable prior backups; active order import/reload exact
backup and target load/import errors preserve original game and open jobs
invalid future schemas dates duplicate ship IDs and altered wages reject
even free materials and zero travel fees cannot make build/sale cycles profitable
conservative construction book value cannot increase wealth on start
R1 prices, trade, rent, bank and sale formulas stay exact; no-order seeded path preserved
actual v9 rent arrears, bank interest and aid marker survive migration without backcharge
